provenance: Fabricated German inputs and declared synthetic nutrition references, not personal records or measured model results. Photo assets must be staged without people or identifying backgrounds and reviewed before any funded run. Offline transport placeholders are not quality fixtures.

evaluation.weighed_tolerance: Calories within 25%; macros within max(5 g, 30%) of declared reference. Reference values are fixture assumptions, not universal food values.
evaluation.arithmetic_tolerance: Labels and portion-only corrections: calories within 5%; macros within max(1 g, 5%).
evaluation.denominators: 17 estimation cases; P5 is a separate non-food control. All 18 attempts count for cost, including failures. One pass is screening, not proof of 95% quality or p95 latency.
evaluation.privacy: No raw prompts, images, estimates, credentials or identities in application logs or shared metrics. Keep any approved synthetic result artifact isolated; null means unknown, never zero cost. No LLM judge.
